what: GitHub CLI authenticated as swapnaliss with repo and workflow scopes
how: gh auth login; gh auth refresh -h github.com -s workflow

how: start the Docker daemon (Docker 29+)

how: read docs/budget.md and approve the cash ceiling and the model-spend plan on the M0-00 issue

how: npx playwright install chromium (after M0-02 pins Playwright)

how: install ffmpeg 8+ on PATH
